title: Decent attempt but awful user experience
body:
The app’s design appears straightforward on first glance. Easy access to menu items and clarity in actions. However, the design is not optimised for iPhones. Menu buttons are at the edges and icons are half hidden outside the perimeter of the screen. This makes the buttons hard, if not impossible, to tap.

The most frustrating feature is the facial recognition whenever you try to access the card details, or settings. It never works properly and causes unacceptable delays in performing an action that is supposed to be quick. ADCB manages to make it the most time consuming and frustrating feature of their app.

وضع الوجه في الاطار عند التحويل هذا افشل ابديت شفته في تطبيق البنك سلبياته اكثر غن ايجابياته 
1. التحويل امام الناس و انا اعمل هالحركات بوجهي 
2. اوقات اعطي لعيالي يحولون لي و لازم وجهي يكون في الاطار 
3. حاطه ماسك على وجهي 
و إلى آخره. 
بعض الحالات الاستثنائية 
خلوه مثل ما كان او طوروها للافضل مو للاسوء 
ابتكار فاشل 
يعني مو كفاية وضع الرقم التعريف الشخصي للمرحلة الاخيرة للتحويل 
او رقم السري للهاتف 
او حتى التعرف ع الوجه حق التلفون 
او ارسال كود بالمسج 

ياليت وضع خيايرين للتحويل في ناس ماتعجبهم هالوجه اللي شرات القرد تحركه في الاطار 
و انا اولهم

title: Disappointing Banking Experience: Credit Card Woes and Poor Customer Service
body: Sorry for saying that recently had an extremely frustrating experience with ADCB, which left me thoroughly disappointed with their services. The primary issue revolved around my credit card, which consistently failed to work despite my numerous attempts to resolve the problem. As a result, I found myself in a troubling situation, unable to make essential purchases or access funds when I needed them the most. First and foremost, the lack of responsiveness from ADCB's customer service team was utterly disheartening. I made several attempts to contact them, spending hours on hold and being transferred from one representative to another, only to receive vague and unhelpful responses. It seemed as though the representatives lacked both the knowledge and the willingness to assist me effectively. This poor level of customer support only added to my mounting frustration. To make matters worse, the credit card issues persisted for an extended period. I experienced embarrassing moments at various stores and restaurants when my card was declined, despite having ample credit available. It was both inconvenient and embarrassing to be caught in such situations, especially when I had confirmed with the bank that there were no issues with my account. Moreover, the lack of proactive communication from ADCB was particularly aggravating. I expected the bank to inform me about any technical glitches or outages that could impact their services, especially regarding credit cards. Unfortunately, I had to discover the problem on my own and continuously reach out to the bank, only to be met with unsatisfactory resolutions. As a loyal customer who has maintained an account with ABCB for several years, I had higher expectations for their service quality. Regrettably, my experience has proven otherwise. The persistent credit card malfunctions and the abysmal customer service have eroded my trust in the bank's ability to address customer needs promptly and efficiently. I strongly urge ADCB to reevaluate its customer service practices and invest in improving its technical infrastructure. Customers should not have to endure such inconveniences and frustrations, particularly when they rely on their banking services for daily transactions and financial stability. In conclusion, my recent encounters with ADCB have been deeply disappointing. The consistent credit card issues coupled with the unresponsive customer service have left me with a bitter taste. I am currently exploring alternative banking options to ensure that I do not have to endure such a dreadful experience again.

author: HarishVarma278

reply.body:
Hi Harish, we are committed to maintaining the highest measures of security. When you save a card at Noon app, the app asks for OTP at the first time only to verify that you're the card holder until you remove the card, however, for any other online purchases, you receive an OTP for each transaction. In addition, you will not be able to save your friend’s card at Noon app unless he provided you with all the card details and the OTP.

title: Fraudulent Bank!!
body:
They will tell you LIES to get you to apply for a credit card and overcharge you for everything! 
And customer service is absolutely useless and would call you a million times to make you do services that you don’t want!

A representative from the bank called me to sell me getting a new credit card which I told her I’m not interested since I already have one, she kept insisting and told me I can use it to pay for my new car’s downpayment. I asked her if I can split it into equal payments over 2 years interest free as other banks have this option, she confirmed several times that it is an option.

I asked her if she is sure if it’s interest free she confirmed again and she said you will only pay 50 dirhams processing fee, and she went back to her manager to confirm with him then she called me back and said he also confirmed that this was an option.

I proceeded with the application based on her confirmation, and when Ireceived the credit card a guy called me to convince me to take cash loan  vs the limist and I told him O’m not interested in this option, and he kept convincing me and nagging in an annoying manner to take the cash loan! And told me intereste free payment was not an option for my card. I told him if it’s not an option I will cancel the credit card because it’s the only reason I did it and I don’t need it for any other purposee. Another guy called me back and he confirmed once again that I have the option of interest free hut over 2 year only and the processing fee is 50 dirhams, I told him it was still fine.

After paying the down payment for my car, I called the customer service to sdo the split payment, he told me there’s a processimg fee of 700 dirhams!! Because the seller is not one of the customers that are a part of this offer! Which no one cared to mention before! I filed a complaint and they said they will go back to the recordings, the decent lady called me vack go tell some lies that she heard the call betweeen me and the ADCB representative where she confirmed that there’s 2 percent interestfee, and that she said that ootion was not there. I told her that’s not true because I wS VERY clear that this isbthe only reason I am doing this credit card and it doesn’t make sense. And if she went back to all the recordings she will find me BLUNTLY saying I will cancel if the option is not there, and that I also have screenshots on whatsapp and voice recordings where she confirmed  that it will be interest free and only 50 dirhams processing fee, she completely dismissesd my evidence and told me I will call you back tomorrow and let you hear the recording!! Completely unacceptable and I will definitively be switching banks!
